verdict.rationale: Retell's in-product AI assistant, Conductor, investigates calls and chats, compares failures to find agent improvements, and explains AI QA trends and low scores. AI QA itself automatically scores calls to surface quality trends and issues, so AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own data are documented first-party. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Conductor's insight quality, and deeper documentation of what suggestion outputs look like beyond brief feature summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Conductor is Retell's AI assistant for building agents, investigating conversations, and improving analytics dashboards.
Filter conversations, inspect transcripts and tool calls, and compare failures to find agent improvements.
Conductor can inspect AI QA cohorts, aggregate results, and individual call evaluations. Ask it to explain a trend or examine the calls behind a low score.
AI QA scores Retell calls on hallucination, knowledge base accuracy, latency, sentiment, and tool usage to surface quality trends and issues.
